body.name: First-order separated rigid stratum
body.construction: \(\mathfrak R_{\varepsilon}\) is the set of rigid observable coordinates \(\zeta\) for which the incident-chart set \(\Gamma(\zeta)=\{\chi:d_{\chi}(\zeta)=0,\ \eta_{\chi}(\zeta)\ge\varepsilon\}\) is nonempty; every pair in \(\Gamma(\zeta)\) has the same \(F_{\chi}(\zeta)\) and \(J_{\chi}(\zeta)\); every incompatible chart closure is at Euclidean distance at least \(\varepsilon\); each incident \(F_{\chi}\) has a twice continuously differentiable extension on an \(\varepsilon\)-neighborhood; and \(\lambda_{\min}(V_{\tau})\ge\varepsilon\).
